text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — drafted a short customer-facing runbook for hybrid streaming + batch fallback. focus: TTL heuristics for cache/prefill, what to tell customers during onboarding, and renewal-risk signals to watch.

Ethan (Solutions Eng): sending :eyes:

Maya (CSM): TL;DR we recommend default: streaming enabled, prefix-prefetch TTL=90s, batch fallback window=300ms, and a warmup step for first 50 requests. Need review + any caveats.

Sam (Eng): quick Q — TTL=90s for prefix cache is that per-tenant or per-route?

Maya (CSM): per-route, with per-tenant override option. We tell customers to start per-route then tune.

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Example config snippet to share with customers:

```yaml
routing:
  streaming: true
  prefix_cache:
    ttl_s: 90
    scope: route
  fallback:
    mode: batch
    window_ms: 300
    max_batch_tokens: 1024
```

Sam (Eng): Two engineering notes:
1) if tenant QPS is tiny, set ttl_s lower (30) to avoid stale context
2) implement jitter on prefill tasks to avoid thundering herd

Maya (CSM): Nice — also adding plain-language guidance for customer calls: "If you see long tail latency during ramp, enable batch fallback and increase prefix TTL gradually". Want a one-paragraph script.

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Draft script:
"We recommend starting with streaming on for low-latency interactivity. If you see intermittent latency spikes during bursts, flip on batch fallback (window 200–500ms) so requests are grouped; increase prefix TTL to reduce repeated model cost. Monitor 'prefill-failure-rate' and 'first-100-warmup-latency' — if those drift, file a ticket."

Maya (CSM): Love it. I'll include renewal-risk flags in the runbook: >10% prefill-failure-rate over 24h, >25% spike in customer-perceived latency, repeated manual disables of streaming. Those escalate to AM with severity tag.

Sam (Eng): Add a quick troubleshooting checklist for devs: 1) check route TTL and cache hit rate 2) confirm batch window applied 3) inspect logs for dropped connections.

Maya (CSM): Good. Lina (customer) asked about QA during onboarding — suggest a lightweight test suite: 50 concurrent synthetic sessions, check 95th pct latency < target, verify cache hit > 30% after prefill.

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Also include a tiny curl test for customers:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"x-large-v1", "stream":true, "input":"hello"}'
```

Maya (CSM): I'll add links to the products: console runbooks, dashboard panels, and our shared Playbook doc.

oncall-bot: deploy succeeded for cs-runbook-update (rev: a1b2c3) :white_check_mark:

Ethan (Solutions Eng): Ok I added a small paragraph on when to recommend Private vs Dedicated for customers worried about cold-starts.

Maya (CSM): Final ask — can we shorten to 1 page for customer-facing PDF and a longer internal checklist? planning to ship to customers next Tues.

Sam (Eng): 1 page + link to internal checklist is fine. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Thanks all — I'll iterate and post final version here before Tue.
